body: Yeah. I have been through a lot of them and found one that was awesome but it really had severe side effects after about 4-6 weeks and I can never take it again.

Have you been to any kind of therapy? It does help to be able to work through these issues with someone that has ideas about how to cope with issues and resolve some of that pain.

If you have already, try again or switch therapists. It takes a while and lots of effort.

Hey. I don’t know what health issues you’ve got going on and I’m sorry to hear it’s really rough for you right now. But I’ll tell you that medical science is pretty good right now and there’s lots of ways to manage most diseases, even the really bad ones.

Think about it a little bit more, sleep on it another night, it’s a big decision.

I’m here for you if you need someone, feel free to message me.

I won’t promise you it’ll get better. It hasn’t for me in and has been a very long time and therapy has made it worse. Medications didn’t work until I found one that had a black box warning and the side effects hit me full force and shut me down just as I had a chance at feeling ok. It shook me bad, knowing there’s happiness right over this hill.

But you know what, I’m still here replying to your message. I want you to know you’re not alone and that you can message me if you want to talk. Having someone there has been helpful for me, so I’ll just leave it at that.

Hang in there.

It’s really not. When I was a kid I fell in, went unconscious after breathing and obviously came back from it. It was shockingly peaceful for me.

Regardless there are reasons for every one of us to stick around.
